Description: SiteProof AWS-B Lite heartbeat alarm CANDIDATE (one alarm over the ProbeCompleted metric of all pages). OFFLINE CANDIDATE / AWS LIVE NOT VERIFIED / AWS-B LIVE NO-GO. AWS has not accepted this template.

Metadata.SafetyGate: AWS-B LIVE NO-GO until separate USER approval
Metadata.Purpose: Detects monitoring that did not run: any page whose probe did not store its result and send its notifications emits no ProbeCompleted datapoint. Lambda Invocations are deliberately not used.
Metadata.Evaluation: Period = schedule interval, Sum < ExpectedPages, 2 of 3 periods, missing data = breaching. Each heartbeat is stamped with its scheduled slot, so one period holds one datapoint per page. One isolated missed run is tolerated; two consecutive missed runs (or total silence) alarm. Whether CloudWatch evaluates this as modelled is LIVE-unverified.
Metadata.PlannedStop: This alarm cannot know about a planned stop. GROUP stop (every page, same end): disable its actions (AlarmActionsEnabled=false, the stopper's HeartbeatAlarmName, or DisableAlarmActions). PAGE stop (one page): do not disable it, lower ExpectedPages by one instead. Residual: a page whose schedule phase is changed can briefly send two datapoints in one period and mask another page's missing one.
Metadata.Cost: One custom metric (ProbeCompleted) and one standard alarm metric. No per-page metric or alarm.

AlertTopicArn.Description: Existing SNS topic. Its policy must allow cloudwatch.amazonaws.com to publish.

MonitorGroup.Description: Must equal the MonitorGroup parameter of every probe stack.

ExpectedPages.Description: Number of probe stacks sending the heartbeat. Fewer datapoints than this in one period count as breaching. Lower it (stack update) when ONE page is stopped for good; leaving it makes the alarm fire until the page returns.

HeartbeatPeriodSeconds.Description: Must equal the probe schedule interval: 21600 for rate(6 hours), 43200 for rate(12 hours). 900 (rate(15 minutes)) exists only so a short LIVE trial can exercise the same alarm in under an hour; it is not a product setting.

AlarmActionsEnabled.Description: false at a planned stop so the silence that follows is not mailed as a failure.

Properties.AlarmDescription: SiteProof monitoring did not run for at least one page (fewer ProbeCompleted heartbeats than expected in 2 of the last 3 schedule intervals). Not proof of a site failure. A planned stop alarms until actions are disabled.

HeartbeatAlarmName.Description: Alarm to disable at a planned stop; pass it to the stopper as HeartbeatAlarmName.
